questions.q: A 500 kg roller coaster car starts at rest 20 m up. (a) Calculate its GPE. (b) Calculate its maximum speed at the bottom (no losses). (c) Explain why the real speed is lower.
questions.a: (a) 500 × 10 × 20 = 100 000 J (2); (b) ½ × 500 × v² = 100 000, v² = 400, v = 20 m/s (2); (c) energy dissipated by friction and air resistance as heat and sound (2).

questions.q: A cyclist does 6000 J of work in 20 s against a resistive force of 50 N. Find the power and the distance travelled.
A 0.5 kg ball thrown upwards at 8 m/s. Calculate the maximum height (no air resistance).
Calculate the KE of a 1200 kg car at 20 m/s.
questions.model: KE = ½ m v². Square speed: 20² = 400. ½ × 1200 × 400 = 240 000 J.

questions.q: A crane lifts 500 kg by 12 m. GPE gained?
Power of a motor doing 1200 J of work in 4 s?
Big question: where does the energy go when a roller coaster goes down?
questions.a: GPE is transferred to KE; some is dissipated as heat and sound by friction and air resistance.
